purpose: Additional historical national SSR/gfs.bern pre-vote poll snapshots for development-only model evaluation,2016–2020.
selection_rule: Initial convenience acquisition based on accessible primary sources, exact recoverability and complete federal vote dates, with two waves for every object. No prediction errors, holdout outcomes or referendum outcomes were used to select objects or extract values.
units: Percentage points on0–100 scale; national vote-intending respondents, not municipal polling or individual-level observations.

mapping.method: Manual date/title match; complete selected dates cross-checked against local identifier projection. vote_key is local string identifier, e.g.6160, not Swissvotes id616. No result columns loaded.

midpoint_policy.reported: Use the source reference/middle interview day when contemporaneously stated. Do not automatically call it a weighted empirical median.
midpoint_policy.calculated: If absent, floor the calendar midpoint: start + floor((end-start)/2) days. Mark approximate and retain the full fieldwork bounds.

later_chart_checks.note: Later wave2 chart, not used to backfill wave1 availability.
Later wave2 trend chart, not used to backfill wave1 availability.

endpoint_sensitivity.definition: delta_yes_pp * (vote_date - wave2_midpoint_days) / (wave2_midpoint_days - wave1_midpoint_days), i.e. uncapped full-linear trend component at factor1. Vary approximate dates over fieldwork endpoints; reported dates stay fixed. Not a statistical confidence interval or an end-to-end model error bound.

limitations: Current pages with announced historic publication dates are not archived pre-vote versions. Every historical_version_verified, captured_before_vote and strict_forecast_ready flag is false.
Current HTML dateModified can reflect a later CMS migration; current content hashes prove the inspected bytes only. Hashes do not prove historical availability or immutability.
Four March2018 rows are verified from primary gfs.bern PDF reports via the web text tool; binary download returned403 and no binary hash is claimed.
The midpoint proxy can change trend slopes and extrapolation. Compare latest-only anchoring, and vary approximate midpoint dates within recorded fieldwork bounds without changing observed shares.
This source-availability sample is not all federal votes in2016–2020. Score missing-poll objects separately and do not condition acquisition on model errors.
Aggregate national polls cannot identify individual voters or municipal electorate proportions.
Only extracted numerical facts, provenance and hashes are redistributed; article prose, reports, photographs and charts retain their publisher rights. No new license on primary material is asserted.
Detailed certain/lean columns intentionally absent. Drop those columns from the existing table before concatenation; do not synthesize unavailable splits.
